zh: **预构建安装**：通过 GitHub 的 dist 分支或版本标签安装已构建的二改包，新增手动发布工作流与安装说明；全新配置默认使用 Claude 品牌、我的角色和首页与对话显示，已有用户设置继续由 profile 配置决定。
en: **Prebuilt installation**: install the built fork from its GitHub dist branch or version tag, with a manual publishing workflow and installation guide; fresh profiles default to the Claude brand, My Character and home-and-conversation placement, while existing profile settings retain precedence.
